articles.summary: MONTRÉAL, QUEBEC / ACCESS Newswire / November 10, 2025 / Loop Industries, Inc. (Nasdaq:LOOP) (“Loop”), a clean technology company accelerating the circular economy, today announced a multi-year offtake agreement with NIKE, Inc. (“Nike”), the global leader in athletic footwear and apparel. Under the agreement, Loop will supply Twist™, its virgin-quality circular polyester resin made exclusively from textile waste, […]
articles.title: Loop Industries Signs an Offtake Agreement with Nike
